scripts.lint: go vet ./... && GOWORK=off go tool -modfile=../core/go.mod golangci-lint run -c ../../.golangci.yml
scripts.test:coverage: mkdir -p coverage && go test -race -coverprofile=coverage/unit.out ./... && node ../../tooling/go-coverage.mjs coverage/unit.out
scripts.format: GOWORK=off go tool -modfile=../core/go.mod goimports -w cmd internal
